description: Rapid workflow for bounded bug fixes, chores, and small tasks. Diagnose, implement the minimum verified change, and prove the outcome.

title.description: What needs to be done (short description)

steps.title: Diagnose: {{title}}
steps.description:
Phase: UNDERSTAND

Before fixing anything, establish the bounded cause and rapid eligibility.

1. Reproduce the problem and trace it to a one-sentence root cause, not a surface symptom.
2. Identify affected callers and the independent executable outcome oracle.
3. Confirm that authorization/security, money or sensitive data, production mutation, schema/migration, public contracts, irreversible external effects, and shared infrastructure are all absent. Unknown means full lane.
4. Record the root cause and eligibility finding on this bead.

Stop rapid execution in the current run and move to the full lane if a protected surface is discovered, the boundary expands, reversibility becomes uncertain, discriminating controls cannot be constructed, root cause remains unresolved, or the outcome oracle is missing. A protected exclusion moves the work to the full lane, where independent review remains available when that boundary calls for it. Preserve the same delegated outcome while changing the workflow lane.

steps.title: Fix: {{title}}
steps.description:
Phase: FIX

Implement the smallest coherent fix with TDD.

1. Write a failing behavioral test that reproduces the failure and kills the named fragile implementation. Include a valid-output positive control and missing-data disposition when relevant.
2. Implement the minimal fix and run the focused proof.
3. Check affected callers without expanding into adjacent improvements.
4. Create an early durable branch, commit, or vertical slice; this is not a PR-readiness signal.
5. Do not open a PR until bounded behavior works, focused proof passes, no objective-blocking work remains, and known limitations and remaining landing proof are stated.

Stop rapid execution in the current run and move to the full lane if a protected surface is discovered, the boundary expands, reversibility becomes uncertain, discriminating controls cannot be constructed, root cause remains unresolved, or the outcome oracle is missing.

The regression test is required and must protect the outcome rather than echo the implementation. Acceptance: {{acceptance}}

steps.title: Verify: {{title}}
steps.description:
Phase: CONFIRM

Verify the outcome, not just that tests pass.

1. Run the exact workflow the user cares about and record the observed user-facing result.
2. Check the acceptance criterion: {{acceptance}}.
3. Check affected callers and resolve any causal blocker to this outcome.
4. Request independent review only when a specialty boundary, task-maturity gap, or named failure mechanism calls for a distinct evidence source. A protected exclusion belongs in the full lane, where targeted review remains available.

Stop rapid execution in the current run and move to the full lane if a protected surface is discovered, the boundary expands, reversibility becomes uncertain, discriminating controls cannot be constructed, root cause remains unresolved, or the outcome oracle is missing.

If the outcome is not achieved, keep working. Record final proof before merge or task closure.
